newsitem.title: USA: Penn National sees Q4 net income $1.1 mln.
newsitem.headline: Penn National sees Q4 net income $1.1 mln.

text.p: Penn National Gaming Inc said Monday it expects to report net income for the 1996 fourth quarter of about $1.10 million, down from $1.15 million a year ago.
The company said it adjusted earnings because of higher interest expense and continued soft results from its Lancaster off-track wagering facility, which opened in July.
Penn National also said its joint venture with Bryant Development Co had completed the acquisition of the Charles Town race track in West Virginia for $16 million.
Penn National said it had increased its equity stake in the joint venture to 89 percent from 80 percent.
It said it expects the facility to be open for racing and gaming in mid-1997.
